messages:
ashley: Following the postmortem for the token-cache eviction incident, let's assign owners for remediation items. I'll start a thread for tracking.

jordan: I'll take 'cache tuning & eviction policy' — will open a Jira.

jira-bot: Created ticket REDW-4123: Cache eviction tuning. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDW-4123

jordan: Link above. ETA: ~2 weeks. Will add test plan + config diff in the ticket.

sanjay: I'll own observability/playbook updates (alerts + runbook). Created REDW-4124 for that.

ashley: Quick RACI draft: Responsible = jordan / sanjay, Accountable = ashley, Consulted = infra (mike, olivia), Informed = product + SRE.

olivia: I'll handle rollout coordination for private clusters; will sync with infra and post rollout checklist here. cc @mike

mike: Happy to support infra changes. Please assign infra subtasks to me on REDW-4124.

pm-ellen: For customer comms — do we need an external note? I can draft if you confirm timeline.

ashley: Yes, please draft. PM draft due by EOD Fri. Assign to @pm-ellen.

jordan: Quick update: pushed initial config to staging, metrics look better (p95 token latency down ~8%). Will open PR tomorrow and reference REDW-4123. :thumbsup: 

oncall-bot: Scheduled weekly smoke check for token-cache evictions on Mondays at 09:00 UTC (id:sched-77).

olivia: I'll update both REDW-4123 and REDW-4124 with owners: R=jordan, S=olivia/mike, A=ashley, I=pm-ellen/SRE. Adding checklist items and rollback steps.

pm-ellen: Draft ready, posting to #customer-communications for review — will wait for timeline confirmation from action owners.

ashley: Great. Let's reconvene in one week in #postmortems for a status check. I'll attach Jira links to the postmortem doc and close action items when all subtasks are done. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
